Seasonal Buoy Program - Anticosti, Banquereau, Bras d'Or Lakes, Browns Bank, Cabot Strait - north, Cabot Strait - south, Chaleur - Miscou - north, Chaleur - Miscou - south, Eastern Shore, Fourchu, Fundy, Grand Manan, Gulf - Magdalen - north, Gulf - Magdalen - south, Gulf - Port au Port - south, Halifax Harbour and Approaches, LaHave Bank, Lurcher, Magdalen Islands, Northumberland Strait, Sable, Southwest Coast, Southwestern Shore
Lifting of floating aids and decommissioning of fixed aids has commenced in the Atlantic South region, in the following areas:
New Brunswick coast, including the Bay of Fundy and Saint John River, Nova Scotia coast, including Cape Breton Island and Bras d'Or Lakes, Prince Edward Island coast, Gulf of St. Lawrence and Northumberland Strait, to the Quebec border.
